page.layout: Two engraved coin medallions at the top, side by side, with no text block of their own. Below them one column of running text. At the foot, a signature at the right. No margin notes.

main_text.l: ZENO Constantinopoli imperat anno mundi 4437. à
Christo nato 475. fuit ex Isauris Ciliciæ, obscuri sanguinis, fa-
cie deformis, moribus tyrannus, ut Isaurũ agnoscas. Hic Theo-
doricum Ostrogothorum Regẽ cum unicè diligeret, Cõsulem
fecit, ac in Italiam aduersus Odoacrẽ misit: occurrẽtem Odoa-
crem Theodoricus prælio vicit, fugauit: fugiẽs Odoacer, intra
mœnia vrbis non admissus, citissimè Rauẽnam cõtendit. trien-
nium ibi obsessus, tãdémque à Theodorico in fidem receptus,
contra fidem truculeter excarnificatur. Pellitur regno Zeno à
Basilisco factione vxoris Augustæ, cùm in Isauriam cõcesisset
maritus Imperator: non multò pòst reuersus Zeno Basiliscũ ex-
pulit, quẽ vnà cum filio inedia mori coëgit. Sunt qui viuum ad-
huc inclusum ab vxore sepulchro tradant. Hoc principe incen-
dium odeò graue fuit, ut præter maximã vrbis partem confla-
gratam, centum & viginti librorum millia combusta sint: inter
quæ & Homeri poëma, intestino draconis 120. pedũ, aureis li-
teris descriptum. Pom. Læt.Pau.Diac.lib.6.Egna.lib.2.
ARIADNA, supradicti Zenonis uxor, fratrem Basiliscum
Imperatorem fecit, filiúmque eius Cæsarem, absente quidem
viro suo, qui rediés[?] supplicium de patre & filio sumpsit, uti iam
dictum est. Bap.Egna.lib.2.Romanorum Principum.

page.notes: The two engraved medallions above the text show, on the left, a laureate bust in profile with a legend around the rim reading approximately "IMP ZENONVS P AVG"; on the right, a draped female bust with a legend reading approximately "ARIADNA ZENO IMP AVG". The rim legends are part of the engraving and are not transcribed as text; the readings are my best reading of the rims and are uncertain. Word "rediés" in the second paragraph: the accent or letter form is doubtful. Long s has been written as plain s throughout. The first paragraph's marginal abbreviations are kept as printed.
